headline: US Court Certifies Class Action for $30 Billion in Tariff Refunds
summary: The US Court of International Trade certified a nationwide class action for importers seeking refunds of unlawfully collected IEEPA duties, involving approximately $30 billion.
why: The Court of International Trade handles disputes over US customs duties and trade actions that directly impact corporate import costs.

impacts.name: US Importers
impacts.why: Certification creates a legal mechanism for affected businesses to reclaim billions in previously paid duties.
